title: Predication cell set
description: JSON Schema for a predication-cell-set Phi = E x Pi x E. The object is presented by its two generators -- an entity-set and a predicate-set. The predication-cell family is generated by the expanding morphism when needed; numeric counts are derived facts of finite settlement, not fields of the transfinite predication object.

entity-set.description: Generator E. Entity-set is reached through the current category path, predicate-set/library/predicate-category/library/category/library/entity-set; it is not a direct child of predication-cell-set.

predicate-set.description: The predicate-set generator. With the entity-set, fixes which predication-cell positions this predication-cell-set indexes: the cell-set is the Cartesian product of the entity-set, the predicate-set, and the entity-set.
